events.detail: Run on the owner's Mac; branch created from origin/stage (ae2957c) because the session's claude/* branch was already merged.
Plan c0ae42f; stories #112 #113 under epic #111; 16 decisions. Owner rules relayed: design tokens only (no hardcoded colors), #114 owns loading UX.
PP Gosha not embedded (licence for facilities.asmbly.org unconfirmed); bold system stack for headings. Roboto first in body stack, not self-hosted.
Logo: official vector from asmbly-classes app/src/lib/components/logo.svelte @9a534a6, inline SVG currentColor. Pattern strip redrawn as inline SVG (no official vector found). CSP unchanged.

Owner confirmed: keep the system heading font (no PP Gosha). Found: the kiln page hotlinks PP Gosha from asmbly.org, but asmbly.org sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so cross-origin fonts likely never load there. Option for later: CORS rule on asmbly.org fonts folder, then hotlink for both pages.
Logo colored once via .logo{fill:currentColor}; header grid layout; token tests are allowlists (SHARED_LITERALS, RESERVED_TOKENS) catching 44 hand-written violations; script and CSP untouched.
Owner may confirm: shared literals between token kinds (1px, 2px, 1rem) are listed in SHARED_LITERALS with reasons.
